protocol.hypothesis: Favorites appear underconfident. Test bounded prior shrinkage changes with same xG/temporal mixture; do not lower publication criteria.
protocol.selection: lowest 2024 pooled 1X2 Log Loss; retain choice and compare to controls on 2025 and 2026 without reselection
protocol.restriction: Stop this batch after these four variants; 2026 already seen, no claim of fresh holdout. No odds, ROI or publication simulation. Not the full live contextual model.

uncertainty.method: Paired bootstrap, 10000 replicates, UTC day and week blocks; descriptive conditional intervals, not a clean independent test or profit evidence

limitations: Local imported source snapshot; baseline may differ from latest production history/details.
Injuries and lineups omitted: current model records them but does not numerically adjust probabilities.
All upcoming fixtures are frozen before kickoff; no outcomes included.
Eligibility is H/A market-level only; no daily ranking or cap simulated.

researchCorrection: Recomputed after fixing goals fallback when both target teams lack usable xG. Current adaptive xG control reproduced exactly in regression tests.
